dz: "威斯敏斯特条约"由英格兰的爱德华四世和苏格兰各岛领主最终确定.
de: The Treaty of Westminster is finalised between Edward IV of England and the Scottish Lord of the Isles.

t: 博斯普鲁斯之战由热那亚人,威尼斯人,阿拉贡人,拜占庭等分舰队在风暴出海入夜.
te: The Battle of the Bosporus is fought in a stormy sea into the night between the Genoese, Venetian, Aragonese, and Byzan…
dz: 海峡之战:博斯普鲁斯之战由热那亚人,威尼斯人,阿拉贡人,拜占庭等分舰队在风暴出海入夜.
de: War of the Straits: The Battle of the Bosporus is fought in a stormy sea into the night between the Genoese, Venetian, Aragonese, and Byzantine fleets.

t: 伊利大教堂的中央塔于12-13之夜倒塌.
te: The central tower of Ely Cathedral falls on the night of 12th–13th.
dz: 伊利大教堂的中央塔于12-13之夜倒塌.
de: The central tower of Ely Cathedral falls on the night of 12th–13th.

dz: 围攻巴格达:蒙古帝国的王子胡莱古·可汗命令他的军队将刚被他们俘虏的巴格达城洗劫一空并掠夺.
de: Siege of Baghdad: Hulegu Khan, a prince of the Mongol Empire, orders his army to sack and plunder the city of Baghdad, which they had just captured.

t: 奥托一世,神圣罗马皇帝和教宗约翰十二世共同签署文凭"奥托尼亚纳姆",承认约翰为罗马的统治者.
te: Otto I, Holy Roman Emperor and Pope John XII co-sign the Diploma Ottonianum, recognising John as ruler of Rome.
dz: 奥托一世,神圣罗马皇帝和教宗约翰十二世共同签署文凭"奥托尼亚纳姆",承认约翰为罗马的统治者.
de: Otto I, Holy Roman Emperor and Pope John XII co-sign the Diploma Ottonianum, recognising John as ruler of Rome.
